Callout.Name: Suspected Hip Fracture
Callout.Message: Person fallen, unable to stand, hip pain.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious on the pavement, leg rotated.

Script.Line: I went down on the step and I have not been able to get up.
The leg is turned out. I can see that it is turned out.
Do not sit me up. Whatever you do, do not sit me up.

Callout.Patient: It is the hip. I heard it go before I felt it.

Lines.Approach: She has been down since the morning and the leg is turned out at the foot.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
